title: Hetzner Cloud server manifest file
description: One server per file under the applying project's hetzner/servers/ directory. Fields track the Hetzner Cloud API server resource shape at https://docs.hetzner.cloud/.

name.description: Operator-facing stable server name (kebab-case). Used as the Hetzner server name and prefixed onto snapshot names.

serverType.description: Hetzner Cloud shared-vCPU server type. cx23 is the shipped default per the round-7 spec section 5.1.

location.description: Hetzner data centre location. fsn1 is the shipped default per maintainer ruling 2026-09-07 09:50Z on the Q2 ratification.

image.description: Hetzner Cloud base image identifier. ubuntu-24.04 is the shipped default.

sshKeyIds.description: Nonempty array of Hetzner ssh-key references. Delegated to security-secrets-management for the actual key material.

networkId.description: Optional Hetzner Cloud private network id. null for no attached private network.

firewallId.description: Existing Hetzner Cloud firewall id to reuse; when null the provisioner creates one from firewallRules.

cloudInitPath.description: Relative path to the rendered cloud-init user-data file. The renderer at src/cloud-init-renderer.mjs consumes contributions/templates/cloud-init.yaml.tmpl and writes the output here.

labels.description: Hetzner tag map. Must include role and blueprint. Under the shared throwaway-server fixture role=rcf-lite-ci-throwaway is required per section 3.3 of the round-7 spec.

firewallRules.description: The rule shape from TAC-3804. Must include an ssh rule (protocol tcp, port 22, direction in, sourceIps nonempty and NOT containing 0.0.0.0/0), an http rule (protocol tcp, port 80, direction in, sourceIps ["0.0.0.0/0", "::/0"]) and an https rule (protocol tcp, port 443, direction in, sourceIps ["0.0.0.0/0", "::/0"]).

snapshotCadence.description: Snapshot cadence per ADR-3802. weekly is the recommended default.

hetznerManagedBackups.description: Optional paid opt-in for Hetzner-managed backups per ADR-3802 (approximately 20 percent of monthly server price).
